WITH data AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES
 ('Dr. Adrián Nolasco','722c10b7-7b6d-4ab2-a6b2-ff04dfd16f8b'),
 ('Dra. Claudia Uchiyama','4c425b9a-357d-464c-a173-7a2ada5647db'),
 ('Dr. Bruno Ccahuana','0be7a37a-66b2-4e0c-8a0e-7a1718dd9d35'),
 ('Dra. Fiorella Quiroz','2be1ad0e-6ee2-4c9f-9e6c-eabc60aed6be'),
 ('Dr. Dennys Palomino','cfe35c25-8ac1-4593-9ec0-794648c8279a')
) AS t(full_name, specialty_id)), branches AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('san_martin'),('los_olivos'),('san_miguel')) AS b(branch)), ins AS (INSERT INTO medical_doctors (full_name, branch, kind, specialty_id, email, phone, active) SELECT full_name, branch, 'especialista', specialty_id, 'demo.especialistas@veterinaria-ariel.local', '999000000', true FROM data, branches WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM medical_doctors x WHERE x.full_name = data.full_name AND x.branch = branches.branch) RETURNING id, full_name, branch) SELECT 'inserted_doctors', count(*) FROM ins;
